description:
Delete a specified field association scheme

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the field association scheme to delete.
parameters.name: id

200.description: Returned if the field association scheme deletion was successful.

400.description: Returned if the scheme that the user is attempting to delete is a system scheme.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions

404.description: Return if the provided ID does not match any existing field association scheme

409.description: Return if the scheme that the user is attempting to delete is still in use.
